hero.title: Activities to book
hero.description: Experiences that need a reservation or tickets in advance. Day-by-day ideas are in the itinerary.

activities.title: Fu Hang Soy Milk (breakfast)
activities.description: The Taiwanese breakfast institution (2nd floor of Huashan Market). No booking: get there early, the queue is long.

activities.title: Turtle Island - whale watching & landing
activities.description: BOOKED (Klook YVS176209) - 2 adults, 1:00pm departure. Meet at 12:20pm on the 1st floor of the Lanyang Museum Wushi Station (Huaqi 168). About 4h. Island cleaning fee payable on site: NTD 100/adult. Passport required (coast guard check). Guiding in Chinese only.

activities.title: Taipei 101 Observatory (sunset)
activities.description: Timed tickets to book ahead: aim for a 5:30pm slot to be up there for sunset (~6:20pm in late August). Late-day slots go fast.

activities.title: Din Tai Fung - Taipei 101
activities.description: Inside the tower itself, so it follows straight on from the observatory. No evening reservations: take a ticket on arrival (30-60 min wait) or stop by before going up to claim a slot.

activities.title: THSR early bird (4 round trips)
activities.description: Discounted tickets (-10 to -35%) open 28 days ahead. Tue Sep 1, Wed Sep 2 and Fri Sep 4: Hsinchu -> Taipei. Sat Sep 5: Hsinchu -> Taichung. Early bird stock is limited: book as soon as it opens.
